subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P5 v3 review cycle done — v4 修復需要 (1 SEVERE + 3 MAJOR)
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P5 v3 review cycle done — v4 修復需要 (1 SEVERE + 3 MAJOR)

## 觸發條件

P5 (vt-crowding-abm) v3 reframe 後 paper-review-cycle round 完成 (commit 1901785a):

- **Academic**: 4.2/5 stars, 0 CRITICAL / 1 SEVERE / 3 MAJOR / 7 MED / 6 MINOR
- **Citation**: 0 MAJOR / 1 MED-blocking / 5 MINOR (5 new bibitems all verified clean)
- **Stage**: 留在 review (NOT promoted to ready_for_submission)

reviews 歸檔: paper/vt-crowding-abm/review_history/v3/{academic,citation}_review_report.md + README.md

## 影響

直接影響 Mission 第 3 條 (top-tier journal 投稿)。v3 reframe 本身 intellectually defensible (family-level threshold argument 一脈相連)，但 reframe 整合留下 3 個 artifact 必須在 v4 修才能投 FRL：

1. §2.4 Simulation Design 仍是 v2 OAT-9 描述，矛盾 §4.5 K1262b 5×4 design — 投稿 desk-reject 信號
2. Table 2 vs Table 4 cell1 baseline 數值不一致 (M=500 vs M=200 sampling noise)
3. Abstract "7×4×12×5" 讀起來像 fully-crossed (應為三層 layered)

加上 v2 carry-over 4/7 (harvey2018 DOI / MC SE / kurtosis CI / fire-sale citation 等) 在 v3 reframe 期間沒處理 — 屬於 reframe 注意力被 narrative 改寫吃掉的疏失。

Predicted FRL outcome 投稿 (post v4): R&R-then-accept ~85%。

## 建議行動

主線程下個 slot 跑 paper-update skill 修 v4 (~2-3 hr):
- S1 + M1 + M2 + harvey2018 DOI + v2 carry-over batch + MED-5/MED-7 + MIN-5
- 重編譯 main.tex 確認 0 errors
- reproduce.py 重跑確認 47/47 GREEN 不退化 (純 narrative + footnote 不應改數字)
- 跑 v4 review round
- 達 latex >=4★ + citation 0 MAJOR + <=3 MED → 升 ready_for_submission

完整 fix list 與 prediction 見 review_history/v3/README.md L120+.
